name: SaneBox
summary: Email triage that moves low-priority mail out of the inbox and works with any provider. The honest catch: you are paying monthly to filter mail that modern email clients increasingly sort for free.
best_for: heavy-email professionals drowning in a cluttered inbox who want AI triage that works across any mail client
skip_if: your inbox is manageable or your mail client's built-in filtering already handles it — you don't need to pay for this
honest_knock: It works with any email provider, which is a genuine advantage over the built-in tools in Gmail and Outlook. But you are paying monthly to filter mail that modern clients increasingly sort for free. The value is real only if your inbox is genuinely overwhelming and native filters are not cutting it. Price it on the plan you would actually keep: the headline rate is a two-year commitment, and month to month the same Snack plan is $9.49 rather than $4.54.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Snack… · per month on a two-year prepay ($109 every 2 years)
pricing.notes: (amounts unchanged since 18 Aug 2026; re-verified 24 September 2026 against the plan data that sanebox.com/pricing embeds for its client-side price cards) Three plans, and the advertised price is the two-year rate. Snack $4.54/mo billed $109 every 2 years, $5.42/mo billed $65 annually, or $9.49 month to month: 1 email account and 2 of the Sane features. Lunch $7.46 ($179 every 2 years) / $9.08 ($109 a year) / $15.99: 2 accounts and 6 features. Dinner $22.04 ($529 every 2 years) / $26.58 ($319 a year) / $42.99: 4 accounts and every feature, plus phone support. The free trial is 7 days with all features on up to 4 accounts. Education, non-profit and government get another 25% off on request during the trial.
